artifacts.synopsis: The Standing Judicial Commission heard an appeal by TE John Grady from his conviction and censure by Southwest Florida Presbytery. The Commission sustained three of seven error specifications but found only one materially prejudicial. Critically, the Commission found that Presbytery misapplied BCO 13-9.c by claiming power to direct the minister to resign and then censuring him for refusal to comply; the Commission vacated the censure and remanded for reconsideration of appropriate punishment while the administrative suspension under BCO 31-10 remained in effect.

In the ROC for these 3 cases, JRP constantly refers to BCO 13-9c and Chapter 23-1 as its authority for postponing the constitutional request of WEPC to dissolve its relationship with TE Robert Wilson.

artifacts.synopsis: Case 2001-34 was decided with Cases 2002-02 and 2002-03. The SJC ruled one constituent complaint out of order, sustained the central challenge to James River Presbytery's delay in acting on a proper congregational request to dissolve a pastoral relationship, and denied the challenge to Presbytery's salary gift. The consolidated decision drew concurring and dissenting opinions.
